notes: Single source of truth for bridge protocol v2. Read at runtime by the HA v2 adapter, by the HA fake gateway in pytest, and by the host-compiled firmware tests (firmware/tests).

Evolution rule: v2 may only grow additively. New actions, new optional result/info fields and new error codes are allowed; changing or removing an existing action argument, field or code requires bridge_version 3.
Consumers must require the fields listed here and ignore unknown extra fields.

identifiers.pause_pollers: Empty string, or comma-separated decimal Pausable Poller indices from the bus's info entry, e.g. "0,2".

result.encoding: One compact JSON object per result text sensor state. Every accepted or rejected probe action produces exactly one result. A request whose request_id is invalid is not published (it cannot be correlated).

common_fields.latency_ms: int >= 0, from frame sent to terminal hub callback; 0 when never sent

responded.values: array of exactly count ints, each 0..65535

info.encoding: Compact JSON published on boot; HA reads it from the initial state after subscribing.

bus_fields.bus: string, the value to pass as the probe action's bus argument
bus_fields.pollers: array of Pausable Poller objects (may be empty)

optional_bus_fields.serial: serial object: the hub UART's parameters as configured in YAML; absent when the firmware cannot tell

poller_fields.index: int >= 0, stable position in the bus's Pausable Poller table; the value to list in pause_pollers
poller_fields.name: string, the component's YAML name, else its id
poller_fields.address: int 0..247, the poller's slave address; 0 when the component has none

lease.encoding: Compact JSON published on the lease text sensor when a Scan Lease begins, when it ends, and in answer to every release action for a known bus.
rules: A Scan Lease begins on the first accepted probe of a scan_id whose pause_pollers is non-empty; that probe's selection is used for the whole lease.
Before the first probe frame is queued, the selected pollers are stopped and the hub's queued frames for their addresses are cleared.
Every accepted probe of the same scan_id renews the lease. The idle timer runs only while no probe of the lease is in flight and starts at the last probe's terminal callback.
The Gateway ends the lease by itself after idle_ms without a probe or hard_limit_ms after it began, and resumes the paused pollers on every ending path.
A probe with a different scan_id ends an active lease (superseded) before it is handled.
Once a lease for a scan_id has ended it never restarts; later probes of that scan_id run without pausing.

fields.pollers: array of the paused Pausable Poller indices (empty when state is none)

timeout_semantics: timeout_ms is applied per probe: when the probe frame is transmitted the firmware sets the hub's send_wait_time to timeout_ms and restores the YAML send_wait_time at the probe's terminal callback. Only one frame is in flight per hub, so this affects only the probe frame.

request_cases.name: write code is refused before any other check
poller index not on this bus
